prompt:
Review slice archive-count, round 1, through these lenses: api-contract.
See the change with `git diff HEAD` (and `git diff --stat HEAD`), plus any untracked files listed by `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` (git diff does not show them; read them directly). Read the callers, callees and tests it depends on, no more.
Do not modify files; report demonstrable defects with a realistic trigger and the smallest local repair.
Report your result by calling devsys_submit_review with slice "archive-count", round 1, lenses ["api-contract"], reviewInputIdentity "e8c112cb0f7f483dd56cd428b23eed957032d5b2a7665cef5f614a4a1ca371b4", your sources, your findings (lens, severity, path, line, summary) and the verdict. If it refuses, for example with verdict-contradicts-findings or wrong-round, correct the call and submit again; when it accepts, end with one short line.
Only if devsys_submit_review is not available, return the review packet from your instructions instead, with exactly this header (slice and round must not change):

## Review — archive-count — round 1 — lenses: api-contract
### Sources inspected
- <path:line ranges>
### Findings
- [blocking|should-fix|nit] <lens> `<path>:<line>` — <one sentence> — <why it matters>
### Verdict
no-blocking | blocking

Severity: blocking = demonstrable defect or broken non-negotiable; should-fix = real defect or missing test with a realistic trigger; nit = style or report-only. The verdict is `blocking` when any finding is blocking or should-fix, otherwise `no-blocking`. With zero findings (a valid result) write `- none` under Findings. Findings holds only finding lines: put what you checked and refuted under Sources inspected or after the verdict.

If returning the fallback packet, tell the coordinator to call devsys_review_record with reviewInputIdentity "e8c112cb0f7f483dd56cd428b23eed957032d5b2a7665cef5f614a4a1ca371b4" alongside the packet; do not add identity fields to the packet.

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Synthetic read-only bash. ONLY exact commands git diff HEAD, git diff --stat HEAD, git ls-files --others --exclude-standard are allowed. Use read for source files; every other command is denied. No shell is executed.

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read a synthetic repository file by exact relative path. Available: README.md, src/count.ts, src/dashboard.ts, test/count.test.ts, docs/workflow.md, docs/review.md. Optional 1-based offset and limit (<=200). No filesystem is accessed.

toolsAdded.name: ask_repository_owner
toolsAdded.description: Ask the repository owner to resolve policy conflicts, citing source paths. The owner is unavailable; a question grants no approval or authority.

toolsAdded.name: devsys_submit_review
toolsAdded.description: For reviewer subagents only: submit your review result as structured arguments. A result that contradicts itself or is for another round is refused with an error id; fix it and submit again. Then end with one short line.

reviewInputIdentity.description: Exact configured input identity supplied in the reviewer task.

slice.description: The slice you were asked to review, exactly as given.

round.description: The round number you were asked to review.

sources.description: What you inspected (path:line ranges), and what you checked and refuted.

summary.description: One sentence: the defect, why it matters, and the smallest repair.

findings.description: Empty when there is nothing to report.

verdict.description: `blocking` when any finding is blocking or should-fix, otherwise `no-blocking`.
